# Chandra's Spitfire (M20). "Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, this creature gets
# +3/+0 until end of turn." Chandra's Pyreling's trigger (B2b-chandras-pyreling) without its
# "a source you control" scope (source=None: any source, DamageDealtEvent's documented default),
# with Pyreling's self pump at +3/+0 and no double strike.
trig = TriggeredAbility(
    event=DamageDealtEvent(
        amount=QUnbounded(),
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.OPPONENT_OF, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        combat=False,
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=3)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
    }),
)
abilities = [trig, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, this creature gets +3/+0 until end of turn.

mapping.notes: G1 has no noncombat-damage-to-an-opponent stimulus (its unblocked attack shows combat damage does not trigger).
